description: Apply Apple design system to all layout components (Sidebar, TopBar, BottomNav) and all pages in the dashboard. Update navigation styles, stat cards, form layouts, table layouts, and all interactive elements. Replace any remaining generic designs with Apple-style components. Ensure consistent spacing, typography, colors, and interactions throughout the entire app. Update icon sizes to 20px everywhere.
steps: Update components/layout/Sidebar.tsx: Nav items - active state bg-[#007AFF]/10 text-[#007AFF] (not full bg-[#007AFF]), hover bg-[#F2F2F7], rounded-lg (10px) padding px-3 py-2.5, icons 20px (w-5 h-5), font-medium 15px, section labels text-[#8E8E93] text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider, border-r border-[#E5E5EA], user avatar rounded-full bg-[#F2F2F7], sign-out button hover:bg-[#FF3B30]/10 hover:text-[#FF3B30]

Update components/layout/TopBar.tsx: Height 60px (h-15 or h-[60px]), border-b border-[#E5E5EA], search input rounded-full (rounded-full) bg-[#F2F2F7] h-9 text-15px placeholder:text-[#8E8E93] focus:ring-2 ring-[#007AFF], bell icon button w-10 h-10 rounded-xl hover:bg-[#F2F2F7], icons 20px

Update components/layout/BottomNav.tsx: Nav items - active text-[#007AFF], inactive text-[#8E8E93], icons 20px (w-5 h-5), font-medium 13px, padding py-3, border-t border-[#E5E5EA], bg-white with backdrop-blur

Update components/residents/AddResidentForm.tsx: All inputs h-11 (44px) rounded-xl, labels font-medium 15px, stepper circles bg-[#007AFF] with ring-4 ring-[#007AFF]/20 for active, completed with Check icon 20px, plan cards rounded-xl border-2 (active border-[#007AFF] bg-[#007AFF]/5, inactive border-[#E5E5EA]), room/food plan icons 20px, price summary card rounded-xl bg-[#F2F2F7] border-[#E5E5EA] padding p-4, buttons follow Apple button styles from FEAT-002, spacing consistent

Update components/rooms/RoomLayoutPreview.tsx: Card rounded-2xl, bed cards rounded-xl padding p-3 border-2 (vacant border-[#34C759] bg-[#34C759]/5, occupied border-[#FF3B30] bg-[#FF3B30]/5), icons 20px, status dots w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full, electricity bill alert rounded-xl bg-[#FF9500]/10 border-[#FF9500]/20

Update app/(dashboard)/dashboard/page.tsx: Stat cards use Card component (already Apple-styled from FEAT-002), icon containers w-12 h-12 rounded-xl with 10% opacity backgrounds, icons 20px, heading font-semibold 22px letter-spacing -0.022em, subtext text-[#8E8E93] 15px, grid gaps gap-4, section cards rounded-2xl

Update app/(dashboard)/residents/page.tsx: Search input and filters match TopBar search style, table uses Apple table styles from FEAT-002 (no grid borders, row separators only), status badges use Apple badge styles, action buttons 20px icons rounded-lg hover:bg-[#F2F2F7], Add Resident button primary Apple button style
Update app/(dashboard)/residents/new/page.tsx: Uses AddResidentForm component (styled in step 4), ensure page wrapper has proper padding and max-width

Update app/(dashboard)/residents/[id]/page.tsx: Header with photo rounded-2xl, tabs use Apple tabs component from FEAT-002, action buttons Apple style, rent/payment tables use Apple table styles, status badges Apple style, all icons 20px

Update app/(dashboard)/rooms/page.tsx: Room grid cards rounded-2xl border-[#E5E5EA] shadow-apple-card, bed icons 20px, vacant/occupied colors (#34C759 / #FF3B30), hover effects translateY(-2px) + shadow-elevated, filters/dialogs Apple style

Update app/(dashboard)/plans/page.tsx: Plan cards or table rows Apple styled, add/edit dialog uses Apple dialog component from FEAT-002, toggle switches already Apple-styled (verified in FEAT-002), meal icons 20px, price display font-semibold text-[#007AFF]

Update app/(dashboard)/rent/page.tsx: Month selector Apple select style, summary cards Apple card style, rent table Apple table style, Collect button Apple button style, status badges Apple badge style, all icons 20px

Update app/(dashboard)/payments/page.tsx: Payment ledger table Apple style (row separators only, hover:bg-[#F9F9FB]), date filters Apple input/select style, receipt icons 20px, reversal badges bg-[#FF9500]/10 text-[#FF9500], Excel export button Apple button style

Update app/(dashboard)/deposits/page.tsx: Tabs use Apple tabs component, deposit cards rounded-xl border-[#E5E5EA], refund eligibility indicators with Apple colors and icons 20px, action buttons Apple style

Update app/(dashboard)/electricity/page.tsx: Bill form inputs h-11 rounded-xl, room selector Apple select style, reading inputs Apple input style, split preview cards rounded-xl, finalize button Apple button primary, per-resident share cards Apple style, Collect buttons Apple style, Zap icon 20px

Update app/(dashboard)/expenses/page.tsx: Add expense form inputs Apple style h-11 rounded-xl, category badges Apple badge style, expense table Apple table style (row separators), date filters Apple input style, total cards rounded-xl bg-[#F2F2F7]

Update app/(dashboard)/reports/page.tsx: Report cards rounded-2xl shadow-apple-card, chart containers Apple style (if charts exist, ensure clean axis lines in #E5E5EA), export buttons Apple button style (Excel/PDF), date range pickers Apple input style, summary cards with Apple colors

Update app/(dashboard)/settings/page.tsx: Form layout with Apple inputs h-11 rounded-xl, labels font-medium 15px, sections separated by separators (bg-[#E5E5EA] h-px), toggle switches already Apple-styled, save button Apple button primary, danger actions (password change) use destructive variant

Update app/(dashboard)/activity-log/page.tsx: Activity table Apple style (row separators only), timestamp badges Apple badge secondary style, entity type badges with Apple colors, filter inputs Apple style, icons 20px, pagination buttons Apple button style

Global icon size enforcement: Search for all Lucide icon usages across all files in this step and ensure className includes 'w-5 h-5' (20px). Common icons: User, Users, DoorOpen, BedDouble, Bed, Receipt, CreditCard, Wallet, Zap, ShoppingCart, BarChart2, Settings, Clock, LogOut, Bell, Search, Check, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, ChevronRight, ChevronLeft, Info, Banknote, Smartphone, Landmark, Coffee, Moon, Sun, Utensils, UtensilsCrossed, Building2, TrendingUp, LayoutDashboard, ListCheck, X. Replace w-4 h-4 with w-5 h-5 everywhere

Verify responsive behavior: Test mobile view (BottomNav visible, Sidebar hidden), tablet view, desktop view. Ensure all Apple styles work across breakpoints. Mobile cards should maintain rounded-xl, proper padding, and touch-friendly sizes (min 44px tap targets)
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar uses Apple navigation styles with proper active/hover states (bg-[#007AFF]/10 for active, not solid fill)
All form inputs are 44px tall with rounded-xl and Apple focus rings
All tables use row separators only (no grid borders)
All cards use rounded-2xl with multi-layer soft shadows
All status badges use Apple badge styles with 10% opacity backgrounds
All buttons follow Apple button interaction patterns (scale on hover, not color change)
Typography uses -apple-system font stack with proper letter-spacing and line-height
Responsive design works on mobile/tablet/desktop with Apple styles maintained
No console errors, app builds successfully
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm no errors
Run 'npm run dev' and open http://localhost:3000
Navigate through every page in the dashboard: dashboard, residents, residents/new, rooms, plans, rent, payments, deposits, electricity, expenses, reports, settings, activity-log
Verify visual consistency: all icons 20px, all inputs 44px, all borders 1px #E5E5EA, all shadows soft multi-layer
Test interactions: button hover (should scale down), input focus (blue ring), table row hover (light gray bg), nav item hover (gray bg)
Test responsive: resize browser to mobile width, verify BottomNav appears, Sidebar hidden, all touch targets minimum 44px
Test AddResidentForm flow completely: select room (see layout preview), select plan (see card selection), verify all steps look Apple-style
Compare against Apple design spec: colors match, typography matches, spacing feels native iOS/macOS
Check browser DevTools: no layout shift, no console errors, smooth animations
